state_rules.insiders: buying: >= $50k discretionary purchases filed in prior 90d and >= sales; selling: >= $1M discretionary sales, no purchases
state_rules.institutions: accumulating: net >= 3 concentrated managers buying or top breadth decile; distributing: mirror
state_rules.crowd: Wikipedia views prior 30d vs prior 182d: high >= 1.5x, low <= 0.67x

signals.name: Insiders buying + institutions accumulating
signals.definition: Insiders bought (>= $50k net, filed in prior 90 days) AND concentrated managers/breadth show accumulation.
signals.rationale: Independent informed groups agreeing should be stronger than either alone.

signals.name: Insiders selling + institutions distributing
signals.definition: Discretionary insider sales >= $1M with no purchases AND institutional distribution.

signals.name: Insiders selling, institutions accumulating
signals.definition: Discretionary insider selling while institutions accumulate.

signals.name: Insiders buying, crowd not paying attention
signals.definition: Insiders buying while Wikipedia attention is at or below normal.

signals.name: Institutions accumulating into crowd attention
signals.definition: Institutional accumulation while attention is high.

signals.name: All three bullish/attentive
signals.definition: Insiders buying, institutions accumulating, attention high.
signals.rationale: Full agreement — or a crowded trade?

attention_returns.interpretation_note: Lag k > 0 correlates today's abnormal attention with the abnormal return k trading days later (attention leads); k < 0 means returns lead attention. Granger shares are compared with the 5% expected under no predictability; 'Granger causality' is predictive precedence, not causation.
